name: knowledge-graph
description: Local, Ollama-free personal knowledge graph in your Obsidian vault. Automatically injects relevant past notes on every prompt and provides /remember and /recall skills plus MCP tools to capture and link decisions, learnings, todos, and code notes.
suggestedPrompts: /remember Capture the key architectural decisions and learnings from this session
/recall What open todos or past decisions do we have in the knowledge graph?
Save a code note and decision memo for the changes we just made
